advice.do: [migration] This property is not declared on the type; declare it or narrow the type. A member of a type parameter is read through its constraint when that is one record declaring it; an indexed `this` type reads as an opaque value; `never` is unreachable.

advice.msg: `Object.assign` writes into its first argument; pass a fresh literal `{}` as the target or spread the sources into a new object
advice.do: [migration] As a statement on a plain record the function owns or was handed (`Object.assign(t, s)`), the target is rebuilt with the sources' declared fields and a parameter target becomes an output. Anywhere else, copy into a fresh object: `Object.assign({}, a, b)` or `{ ...a, ...b }`.

bound.fakes: demand-driven proxies, seeded primitives, seeded recorded clocks
bound.inputs: from parameter types with boundary values first; positions of one shape sometimes share one object
bound.observation: outcome, the reachable object graph (identity up to a renaming of fresh objects), receiver fields, trace, pending work
bound.schedule: after the call: every armed timer once, in due order (ties by arm order), intervals re-armed and left pending, at most 50 fired
